value.rationale: The fixed-side-ratio isosceles subfamily is a natural sharp test for the universal planar perimeter lower inequality. The complete and unique equilateral maximizer, two degenerate boundaries with distinct logarithmic orders, and exact local quadratic deficit distinguish geometrically different collapsing mechanisms; no universal upper/lower mean bound alone yields these rates. This is a complete one-parameter geometric classification rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
